name: New York
utility: New York City Water Board · NYC DEP

supply.note: Effectively a single surface system — Catskill/Delaware and Croton.

history.note: Back-series recomputed under TWJ-R180-v1.0 from the Water Board's published rate history.

open_items: Nothing outstanding. The minimum-charge question that withheld this city since v1.2 is resolved as not_applicable at the reference volume.
resolution_note: Withheld 17 August 2026 under Rule 7.6 on the hypothesis that the Rate Schedule set minimum charges by meter size. It sets one at USD 0.49 per day instead — wrong about the form, right that something existed. Modelled as a floor on the bill, which does not bind at 15 m3 and does bind below about 7.9 m3, lifting the 5 m3 curve point from USD 1.89 to USD 2.982.
